title: Web application developer
summary: Ten years building and running Drupal platforms for NGOs, public administrations and news media, as a backend developer and technical lead.
highlights: Mentoring and technical leadership in teams of up to ten people.
Server-side backend development and custom Drupal modules.
Integrating single-page applications — Angular, Vue — into Drupal.
Designing, building and operating databases, and the REST applications on top of them.
Content migrations into Drupal from WordPress, Fatwire, ezPublish and older Drupal, with thousands of items.
Authentication integrations: OpenID Connect and Microsoft Azure Active Directory.
Syncing site data into CRMs such as Salesforce and Microsoft Dynamics.
Building and evolving continuous integration systems.
Working directly with clients to scope requirements, plan the work and publish the result.
